resolved_concerns: Mixed grid/binary edge counting does not require distinct geometric difference vectors: injective endpoint labels prove disjoint counted unordered pairs.
Potential rational-function denominator degeneration is controlled by a fixed closed algebraic enclosure in the genericity argument.
Only local stability of facets is needed; no global exposed-face continuity theorem is required.
One-dimensional odd-distance coloring is directly bipartite for every norm.
